name: arquivo-arrakis
description: Ambiente local do Arquivo Arrakis com WordPress, MCP e Codex CLI.

scripts.wp:bootstrap: wp-env run cli wp plugin activate mcp-adapter arrakis-core && wp-env run cli "wp rewrite structure /%postname%/" && wp-env run cli wp rewrite flush --hard && wp-env run cli wp option update blogname 'Arquivo Arrakis'
scripts.wp:status: wp-env run cli wp plugin status mcp-adapter && wp-env run cli wp plugin status arrakis-core
scripts.mcp:check: wp-env run cli wp mcp-adapter list -- --format=json
